commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: The kiln's lever draws all three gate chains. One pull can close the whole yard.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: A prison that calls itself a workplace.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: The clerk has tied the binding to the last chain. Cut the chain, keep the book.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: The tender follows the heat vents. It was his last duty.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: Then we stop feeding the duty. No more charcoal goes in.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: Keep every warning line visible. We need our way out as much as the way in.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: I can open the first link from this side.
